content:
Earlier this year in May, OpenAI released a mobile application designed for enterprise use. Now, SpaceXAI is launching a similar version for Grok.

Grok for Intune is now available

The new enterprise-focused app is called Grok for Intune. According to SpaceXAI, this new dedicated app is "the Microsoft Intune version of Grok—the AI assistant under xAI—designed for businesses that use Intune to manage applications and data."

The company stated: "It supports Intune mobile application management, complies with enterprise application protection policies, and signs in with a corporate email."

SpaceXAI has listed the key features of Grok for Intune:

AI Assistant – Ask any question and get quick answers; conduct in-depth online research, or tackle difficult problems in mathematics, science, and coding. Upload documents and photos, or paste links, and let Grok analyze and explain the content. Grok Imagine – Generate stunning images from simple text prompts, or upload images for Grok to edit—remove objects, change scenes, or apply any artistic style. Create short videos with sound effects from text prompts, or transform static photos into videos. Voice Mode – Have a conversation with Grok and receive natural, pleasant replies hands-free. Live Camera: Share what you see, and let Grok analyze it in real time. Real-Time Information – With access to the web and X's data, Grok's answers stay up to date with the latest news, trends, and developments on any topic. Built for Managed Devices – Deployed and configured by enterprise IT teams through Microsoft Intune. Complies with corporate application protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing, and data transfer. Sign in with a corporate email. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available on the App Store.
